items.text: How do midwives, obstetricians, booking clerks, bed managers and women experience the scheduling and starting of induction of labour on the unit, and which parts of the booking process do they see as causing delay and unsafe workload?
items.population: Staff across the booking chain and women with a delayed induction in the last year
items.outcome: Experiences of scheduling, waiting and workload; perceived causes and remedies
items.setting: Labour and birth unit and antenatal clinic

finer: Feasible within one protected day per week and shift constraints; interesting to the unit's redesign group; novel in including the booking chain; ethical with careful approach to women after difficult births; relevant to the 2027 redesign.
summary: One SPIDER question covering the whole booking chain.
